name: validate_email
description: Validates email format using pattern matching
code:
-- validate_email.lua
-- Validates an email address against RFC 5322 simplified pattern

local function validate_email(email)
    if type(email) ~= "string" then
        return false, "Input must be a string"
    end

    if #email == 0 or #email > 254 then
        return false, "Email length out of range"
    end

    local pattern = "^[%w%.%%%+%-]+@[%w%.%-]+%.%a%a+$"
    if not email:match(pattern) then
        return false, "Invalid email format"
    end

    local local_part, domain = email:match("^(.+)@(.+)$")
    if #local_part > 64 then
        return false, "Local part exceeds 64 characters"
    end

    -- Check for consecutive dots
    if email:find("..") then
        return false, "Consecutive dots not allowed"
    end

    return true, "Valid email"
end

return validate_email

name: hash_password
description: Hashes a password with salt using SHA-512 via built-in crypto
code:
-- hash_password.lua
-- Secure password hashing with salt and iteration

local crypto = require("metabuilder.crypto")

local ITERATIONS = 10000
local HASH_LENGTH = 64

local function hash_password(password, salt)
    if type(password) ~= "string" or #password < 8 then
        error("Password must be at least 8 characters")
    end

    if type(salt) ~= "string" or #salt < 16 then
        error("Salt must be at least 16 characters")
    end

    local derived = crypto.pbkdf2({
        password = password,
        salt = salt,
        iterations = ITERATIONS,
        hash = "sha512",
        length = HASH_LENGTH
    })

    return string.format(
        "$pbkdf2-sha512$i=%d$%s$%s",
        ITERATIONS,
        crypto.base64_encode(salt),
        crypto.base64_encode(derived)
    )
end

return hash_password

name: format_date
description: Formats a UNIX timestamp into human-readable date strings
code:
-- format_date.lua
-- Flexible date formatting from UNIX timestamps

local FORMATS = {
    iso8601  = "!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",
    short    = "%Y-%m-%d",
    long     = "%B %d, %Y %H:%M",
    relative = nil,
    rfc2822  = "!%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT"
}

local function relative_time(timestamp)
    local diff = os.time() - timestamp
    if diff < 60 then return "just now" end
    if diff < 3600 then return math.floor(diff / 60) .. " minutes ago" end
    if diff < 86400 then return math.floor(diff / 3600) .. " hours ago" end
    if diff < 2592000 then return math.floor(diff / 86400) .. " days ago" end
    return math.floor(diff / 2592000) .. " months ago"
end

local function format_date(timestamp, format)
    timestamp = tonumber(timestamp)
    if not timestamp then
        error("Invalid timestamp")
    end

    format = format or "iso8601"

    if format == "relative" then
        return relative_time(timestamp)
    end

    local fmt = FORMATS[format]
    if not fmt then
        error("Unknown format: " .. format)
    end

    return os.date(fmt, timestamp)
end

return format_date

name: send_notification
description: Sends a notification through the event bus to subscribed channels
code:
-- send_notification.lua
-- Dispatches notifications through the MetaBuilder event bus

local eventbus = require("metabuilder.eventbus")
local json = require("metabuilder.json")

local CHANNELS = {
    email = { priority = 1, retry = 3 },
    push  = { priority = 2, retry = 1 },
    sms   = { priority = 3, retry = 2 },
    slack = { priority = 2, retry = 2 },
    webhook = { priority = 4, retry = 5 }
}

local function send_notification(user_id, message, channel)
    if not user_id or #user_id == 0 then
        return { success = false, error = "user_id is required" }
    end

    if not message or #message == 0 then
        return { success = false, error = "message is required" }
    end

    channel = channel or "push"
    local ch_config = CHANNELS[channel]
    if not ch_config then
        return { success = false, error = "Unknown channel: " .. channel }
    end

    local payload = {
        type = "notification",
        user_id = user_id,
        message = message,
        channel = channel,
        priority = ch_config.priority,
        timestamp = os.time(),
        retry_count = ch_config.retry
    }

    local ok, err = eventbus.publish("notifications", json.encode(payload))
    if not ok then
        return { success = false, error = err }
    end

    return { success = true, id = payload.timestamp, channel = channel }
end

return send_notification

name: check_permissions
description: Checks user permissions against ACL rules from JSON config
code:
-- check_permissions.lua
-- ACL permission checker against JSON-defined rules

local dbal = require("metabuilder.dbal")
local json = require("metabuilder.json")

local ACTIONS = { "read", "write", "delete", "admin" }
local ACTION_HIERARCHY = { read = 1, write = 2, delete = 3, admin = 4 }

local function check_permissions(user_id, resource, action)
    if not user_id or not resource or not action then
        return false, "All parameters are required"
    end

    if not ACTION_HIERARCHY[action] then
        return false, "Invalid action: " .. tostring(action)
    end

    local user = dbal.get("core", "users", user_id)
    if not user then
        return false, "User not found"
    end

    if user.role == "god" then
        return true, "God role: unrestricted"
    end

    local acl = dbal.get("core", "acl_rules", resource)
    if not acl then
        return false, "No ACL rules for resource"
    end

    local allowed = acl.roles[user.role]
    if not allowed then
        return false, "Role not permitted"
    end

    local required_level = ACTION_HIERARCHY[action]
    local granted_level = ACTION_HIERARCHY[allowed.max_action] or 0

    return granted_level >= required_level,
           granted_level >= required_level and "Permitted" or "Insufficient privileges"
end

return check_permissions

name: generate_slug
description: Generates URL-safe slugs from arbitrary text with transliteration
code:
-- generate_slug.lua
-- URL-safe slug generation with Unicode transliteration

local TRANSLITERATE = {
    ["a"] = "a", ["o"] = "o", ["u"] = "u",
    ["A"] = "A", ["O"] = "O", ["U"] = "U",
    ["n"] = "n", ["c"] = "c", ["e"] = "e",
    ["ss"] = "ss"
}

local function generate_slug(text, max_length)
    if type(text) ~= "string" or #text == 0 then
        error("Input text is required")
    end

    max_length = max_length or 80
    local slug = text
    slug = slug:lower()
    for from, to in pairs(TRANSLITERATE) do
        slug = slug:gsub(from, to)
    end
    slug = slug:gsub("[^%w%-]", "-")
    slug = slug:gsub("%-+", "-")
    slug = slug:gsub("^%-+", ""):gsub("%-+$", "")
    if #slug > max_length then
        slug = slug:sub(1, max_length)
        local last_hyphen = slug:find("%-[^%-]*$")
        if last_hyphen and last_hyphen > max_length * 0.5 then
            slug = slug:sub(1, last_hyphen - 1)
        end
    end
    return slug
end

return generate_slug
